stories.story_fr: Assurant signe le meilleur trimestre de son histoire au Q1 2026, porte par des benefices records dans Global Lifestyle, ce qui pousse la societe a relever son objectif annuel d'EBITDA et de BPA des le premier trimestre.
stories.story_en: Assurant delivered its best quarter in history in Q1 2026, driven by record earnings in Global Lifestyle, prompting an enterprise outlook raise on both Adjusted EBITDA and EPS.
stories.quote: Our first quarter performance represented Assurant's best quarter in history driven by record earnings in Global Lifestyle... Driven by our strong start to the year, we are increasing our 2026 enterprise outlook.

stories.story_fr: Connected Living acquiert de la traction avec une croissance des abonnes aux programmes de protection mobile et des volumes de reprise (trade-in) en hausse, moteur central de la progression de 11% des primes Lifestyle au Q1 2026.
stories.story_en: Connected Living gains traction through subscriber growth in mobile protection programs and higher trade-in volumes, the core driver of the 11% Lifestyle premium growth in Q1 2026.
stories.quote: Connected Living results benefitted from subscriber growth in mobile protection programs and trade-in performance... driven primarily by Connected Living growth from higher trade-in volumes and global mobile protection programs.

stories.story_fr: Assurant mise sur des plateformes activees par l'IA et des capacites data-driven pour etendre ses positions de leader et ameliorer les resultats pour les consommateurs finaux des marques partenaires.
stories.story_en: Assurant leans on AI-enabled platforms and data-driven capabilities to expand its market-leading positions and improve outcomes for end consumers of partner brands.
stories.quote: Through continued investments in technology, including AI-enabled platforms, we are poised to expand our market-leading positions and create further shareholder value.

stories.story_fr: Global Housing capte la pression du marche de l'assurance volontaire avec des polices lender-placed en hausse, soutenant une croissance de 11% des primes du segment au Q1 2026.
stories.story_en: Global Housing captures voluntary insurance market pressure with rising lender-placed policies in-force, supporting 11% segment premium growth in Q1 2026.
stories.quote: growth within Homeowners from higher lender-placed policies in-force and increased contributions from specialty products... higher lender-placed policies in-force which benefitted from voluntary insurance market pressure.

stories.story_fr: Assurant entre sur de nouveaux marches attractifs avec le lancement d'Assurant Home Warranty, finance par des investissements organiques, ouvrant une voie vers le leadership sur un nouveau segment.
stories.story_en: Assurant expands into attractive new markets with the launch of Assurant Home Warranty, funded by organic investments, opening a clear path to market leadership in a new segment.
stories.quote: continued growth in attractive, expanding markets - including the recent launch of Assurant Home Warranty... expansion into attractive new markets where we see a clear path to market leadership.

stories.story_fr: Assurant boucle 2025 sur une troisieme annee consecutive de croissance a deux chiffres du benefice et du BPA, et une neuvieme annee consecutive de croissance rentable.
stories.story_en: Assurant closed 2025 with a third consecutive year of double-digit earnings and EPS growth, and a ninth consecutive year of profitable growth.
stories.quote: Delivered Third Consecutive Year of Double-Digit Earnings and EPS Growth... delivering our ninth consecutive year of profitable growth.
